My wife and I just started working out of the house and we immediately realized our normal routine of buying 20 oz bottled water was not going to work any longer. With that being said, this was a big decision so I did significant research to turn this into an investment in future savings.

The delivery was as advertised so I did not mind paying for the additional shipping charges. It's a rather large box and it's not like they are throwing books or boxed items into a larger box with a purchase like this. Once inside, it was easy to open and no assembly was required other than letting it level right side up before hooking up your first bottle and turning it on. As with any unfamiliar item, take time to read the instructions first!

I let it sit over night to cool/heat so I could try it out first thing in the morning. The water is as cold as you want it (colder than our fridge) and the hot is almost near boiling, which is great for tea or even a french press. Other reviews described a "sweet" flavor during their first water jug but I did not notice anything at all. Be sure to level the cooler to avoid any unwanted vibrations. It does make noise but it is quiet and not a distraction and is quieter than every other appliance in our kitchen.

For those of you on the fence...

Would I buy this again? Yes.
Would I pay the same amount? Yes, maybe even a few bucks more
Was it a great investment? Yes

I ordered this on a Saturday from the 3rd party vendor Reil Machines. They shipped it out this past Monday and I had it on my door step by 5 PM Wednesday. Thank you, Reil Machines!

The instructions said it would take almost an hour for cold water but the kids tried 30 minutes later before bed and it was already cold. (by the way, never buy a Primo, they are junk - no cold water prompted this buy, but that Saturday when I replaced the water, the pump no longer worked also and it was only a year out of a first warranty replacement too!) I digress, so far this machine is great. It even weighs less than the Primo model I had making it much easier to pick up and move. I will edit this post after several months. Due to my issues with the Primo water dispenser having to be replaced 2x inside warranty, I bought a Squaretrade warranty for this. I really hope I don't have to use it.

We purchased this water cooler to replace a top-loading cooler from our water supplier. The only reason I gave it three stars and not five was because of the experience I had with the manufacturer's customer service. When I received the cooler it had a very slight  raised bump in the metal underneath the section where the water comes out. Not very noticeable.  When I contacted customer service they were not the best in dealing with this issue.  I ended up keeping the cooler rather than throwing it out and waiting for a new one to come, which is what the manufacturer wanted me to do.  All in all, I am extremely satisfied with the cooler & would highly reccomend it to anyone looking for a cooler!

This replaced a similar (different brand) one that was in an identical enclosure, minus the sticker. The previous one used an air pump to pressurize the water bottle and required a significant attachment mechanism and was quite loud when pumping. It could not fill as fast as the water could dispense. Also the old one would beep all night if someone emptied the bottle before bed.

This one seems to be directly pulling the water via suction, is very quiet, and can keep up with the dispense rate. It has a simple light to indicate the bottle is empty and doesn't beep at you. The bottle attachment simply pushes on and pulls off. So much nicer.
